content.text:
The Friday rule (no start after 15:00) was already in `src/solution.py`, so I left it as it was. I didn't run any checks on the change.

I made one change. The conflict check used `cs <= be`, so a meeting couldn't start at the exact moment an event or lunch ended. That blocked a 13:00 start after lunch, for example, which isn't a real conflict. I changed it to `cs < be`, so back-to-back meetings are now allowed. Only genuine overlaps are rejected.

I left everything else alone, including the date-to-weekday conversion.
